newsitem.title: USA: Stewart gets $68 mln gas generator order.
newsitem.headline: Stewart gets $68 mln gas generator order.

text.p: Stewart & Stevenson said Tuesday it received two orders for gas turbine generators during the month of March.
The combined value of the two orders, which includes five LM6000 gas turbines, is $68 million, it said in a statement.
The two unit order also includes options for up to an additional seven turbine generator sets which could be exercised over the next 18 months, the company said.
If all the options are exercised, the order has potential value exceeding $100 million.
Stewart & Stevenson, based in Houston, Texas, is a manufacturer of diesel and gas turbine powered equipment.
